boundary.reason: Tracked-state-only Phase 1.5 proof step. This run validated the local mirror against the checked-in archive and did not fetch Substack or mutate any external service.

task.objective: Determine the next valid bounded publish-adjacent action for the package and execute one local archive-sync sub-step without external mutation.
task.stop_condition: The next stage is resolved and one local validator command completes with a reviewable log.
non_goals: Do not refresh the archive from Substack.
Do not mark archive_sync done from local validation alone.
Do not perform downstream distribution work.

required_context.name: repo root environment with archive scripts available
up-to-date publication metadata or recently published post

expected_outputs: updated archive metadata and README publication map
done_when: the archive refresh completes successfully and the mirror validation pass is clean
tracked_state_observations: The checked-in archive already contains `publication_strategy_and_archive/substack_archive/2025-11-27_neural-architecture-design-as-a-compositional-32e.md` and the matching HTML snapshot.
The checked-in post map already maps slug `neural-architecture-design-as-a-compositional-32e` to `publications/neural-architectures/neural-architecture-design-as-a-compositional-32e`.

checks.name: next_stage_resolution
checks.notes: The tracked harness resolved `archive_sync` as the next valid stage and reported `can_execute: true`.

checks.name: mirror_build
checks.notes: Eleventy rebuilt the local mirror and emitted the package route for this slug.

checks.name: mirror_static_validation
checks.notes: `scripts/check_mirror.py` completed successfully over the checked-in archive and built output.

checks.name: mirror_e2e_smoke
checks.notes: `scripts/e2e_mirror_smoke.py` completed successfully for the normal mirror path prefix.

verification.residual_risk: This bounded step did not run the remote archive refresh and did not validate the `/content/` prefixed mirror mode. `archive_sync` therefore remains incomplete.

possible_failures: The local mirror can pass while the remote Substack feed or archive API has diverged.
The normal mirror path can pass while the GitHub Pages `/content/` path prefix still has an issue.
The stage could be mistaken as complete even though only a local validation sub-step ran.

output_excerpt: Resolved next_stage=archive_sync with can_execute=true and approval_gate=none, then passed the normal local mirror build and validators without external mutation.
